name: B♭ Orchestral Trumpet
shortDescription: Three-piston brass aerophone with cylindrical bore terminating in an exponential flare bell.
description: The trumpet functions as a lip-reed aerophone. The musician's buzzing lips serve as an acoustic valve controlling air stream pulses into a standing longitudinal sound wave within 1.4 meters of wrapped brass tubing.
historicalOrigins: Evolved from natural signal horns and coiled cavalry trumpets; revolutionized in 1818 by Stölzel and Blühmel's invention of the Périnet piston valve.
acousticPrinciples: Lip-reed excitation: Lips act as a pressure-controlled biological valve oscillating at acoustic feedback resonance
Standing wave column: Longitudinal pressure nodes and antinodes formed in air column
Exponential bell impedance match: Flare matches internal high acoustic impedance to low ambient room impedance, radiating high harmonics

characteristics.timbralColor: Piercing, brilliant, noble, cutting, commanding brilliance
characteristics.orchestralRole: Fanfare leader, dramatic climax, harmonic brass choir soprano

soundDNA.exciter: Oscillating human lips (embouchure) pressed against cup mouthpiece
soundDNA.resonator: 1.4m yellow brass acoustic air column with exponential flare bell
soundDNA.harmonics: Complete harmonic series aligned by bell flare and mouthpipe tapering
soundDNA.attackDecay: Direct sustained aerodynamic excitation with instant tonguing attack
soundDNA.timbreProfile: Brilliant brassy envelope with dramatic high harmonic saturation at forte
soundDNA.radiationPattern: Highly directional forward acoustic beam emitting from the bell

bell.label: Exponential Flare Bell
bell.function: Transforms planar pressure waves inside tubing into spherical waves; radiates upper partials.

characteristics.material: One-piece hand-hammered yellow brass (70% copper / 30% zinc)

valves.label: Three Périnet Piston Valves
valves.function: Reroutes air stream into auxiliary tubing loops, instantly lengthening the acoustic column to lower pitch.

characteristics.material: Monel nickel-copper alloy pistons in honed brass casings
characteristics.mechanism: Tri-port air diverter pistons with stainless steel springs

leadpipe.label: Leadpipe & Tuning Slide
leadpipe.function: Gradually expands air stream diameter from mouthpiece to main valve block; slides to tune concert pitch.

characteristics.mechanism: Venturi taper acoustic compressor and telescoping slide

mouthpiece.label: Cup Mouthpiece
mouthpiece.function: Couples vibrating lips with the air column; cup depth and throat diameter shape timbre brightness.

characteristics.material: Machined solid brass finished in 24k gold or silver plate
characteristics.mechanism: Acoustic cup capacitor and throat nozzle

tubing.label: Valve Slide Loops
tubing.function: 1st slide lowers pitch by 1 tone; 2nd slide by semitone; 3rd slide by 1.5 tones.

characteristics.material: Drawn seamless brass tubing with water key spit valve

followTheSound.title: Lip Embouchure Buzz
followTheSound.explanation: Player blows pressurized air between tightened lips, creating rapid pressure pulses into the mouthpiece cup.

followTheSound.title: Acoustic Column Coupling
followTheSound.explanation: The venturi taper in the leadpipe matches acoustic impedance and guides shockwaves into the tubing.

followTheSound.title: Valve Port Selection
followTheSound.explanation: Depressing pistons reroutes the wave through auxiliary tubing loops, changing fundamental resonant frequency.

followTheSound.title: Longitudinal Standing Wave
followTheSound.explanation: Acoustic waves reflect back and forth within the brass column, establishing standing pressure modes.

followTheSound.title: Bell Radiation & Projection
followTheSound.explanation: The exponential flare bell converts internal acoustic pressure into free-field sound waves that cut through an orchestra.
